description.short: Manage ClickUp tasks, docs, and chat from Microsoft 365 Copilot.
description.full: Connect Microsoft 365 Copilot to your ClickUp workspace — manage tasks, track time, search documents, and chat without switching context. The plugin connects to ClickUp's hosted MCP server; on first use you authorize with your ClickUp account via OAuth.

agentConnectors.description: ClickUp's hosted MCP server, providing tools for tasks, documents, chat, time tracking, and workspace search.
